transcript:
Call CALL-1041 — Northwind Logistics (ACC-1041) — 2026-06-02 15:30 UTC
Participants: Dana Ferris (Account Manager, us) / Colin Okafor (Operations Lead, customer)

Dana: Thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through where we landed on the renewal terms.

Colin: Sure. Honestly the main thing on my mind is the seat count. We're not going to need eighty next year.

Dana: Understood. What are you thinking?

Colin: Sixty, maybe sixty-five. We consolidated two teams in April.

Dana: That's workable. I'll put together a revised quote at sixty-five and send it over tomorrow.

Colin: Appreciated. I'll need to run it past Priya in finance before I can sign anything.

Dana: Of course. Anything else you want reflected in the quote?

Colin: No, that's the main one. The product's been solid this year, no complaints.

Call CALL-2288 — Halcyon Retail Group (ACC-2288) — 2026-06-04 10:00 UTC
Participants: Jamal Reyes (Account Manager, us) / Simone Voss (Merchandising Director, customer)

Jamal: Morning. Just a quick check-in, I know you're heads down on the holiday planning.

Simone: We are, yeah. Nothing much to report from our end.

Jamal: No worries. Usage looked steady last month, nothing flagged.

Simone: Good to hear. We'll probably have more to talk about after the quarter closes.

Jamal: Sounds good, I'll leave you to it.

Call CALL-3390 — Vantage Health Partners (ACC-3390) — 2026-06-09 18:15 UTC
Participants: Marcus Whitfield (Senior Account Manager, us) / Renata Boyle (Director of Analytics, customer)

Marcus: I saw the ticket about the export timeouts. I wanted to talk about it directly.

Renata: It's been three weeks, Marcus. My analysts can't pull their monthly reports. This is the second time this year.

Marcus: That's not acceptable and I'm sorry. I've escalated it to engineering as a P1.

Renata: I've heard that before. Look, we're up for renewal in November and my director has started asking what else is out there.

Marcus: I hear you. I'll get you a written fix timeline from engineering by end of week, and I'll set up a call with our VP of Engineering.

Renata: The timeline is what I need. I'll hold off on the rest until I see it.

Marcus: Understood. End of week, in writing.
